tasks.description: Add a scoped text-selection override to SttView's `static styles`. Inside the `css` template at src/ui/listen/stt/SttView.js (the `static styles` block spans lines 4-79; `.transcription-container` is defined at line 12), add: `.transcription-container, .transcription-container * { user-select: text !important; cursor: text !important; }`. This mirrors AskView.js:105-108 (`.response-container, .response-container *`) and ListenView.js:39-42 (`.insights-container ...`) verbatim. CONTEXT/RISKS: (1) The override MUST live in SttView's own `static styles`, NOT ListenView.js — the blocking `* { user-select: none }` (ListenView.js:35) is an INHERITED value crossing the `<stt-view>` shadow-host boundary, so a parent-scope rule cannot reach SttView's encapsulated `.transcription-container`. (2) Scope to `.transcription-container, .transcription-container *` (matches AskView's `<container>, <container> *` shape) to cover cross-bubble drag selection — do NOT scope to `:host`/`*` (would make chrome selectable) nor only `.stt-message` (would miss cross-bubble drag). (3) Do NOT touch the capture/streaming path; mid-stream auto-scroll interrupting an in-progress selection is an ACCEPTED limitation (spec Edge Cases). (4) Do NOT modify the `getTranscriptText()` state path (SttView.js:191-193) — the 'Copy transcript' button is state-driven and must remain unchanged (FR-003). No JS, no new state, no CW backend (FR-006).
tasks.verify: SttView.static styles contains `.transcription-container, .transcription-container * { user-select: text !important; cursor: text !important; }`; getTranscriptText() unchanged; no other file modified (per quickstart.md manual steps 1-6)
